top_news.title: Enhancing Extubation Failure Prediction with LLM-Derived Features from Respiratory Therapy Clinical Notes
top_news.dek: Researchers developed a pipeline using LLMs to extract clinical features from respiratory therapy notes to improve extubation failure prediction.
top_news.brief: The study introduces a method to classify free-text clinical notes into structured features, which are then fed into a logistic regression model. This approach aims to provide more accurate, timely predictions for patient extubation outcomes by leveraging unstructured data from electronic health records.

top_news.title: Breaking the 1.58-bit Barrier for Ternary LLMs
top_news.dek: New research suggests ternary LLMs can exceed the 1.58-bit efficiency threshold by optimizing for non-uniform symbol distributions.
top_news.brief: While ternary models are theoretically 1.58 bits per weight, practical implementations often round up to 1.625 bits. By analyzing 29 models, researchers found that zeros account for over 50% of weights, suggesting that entropy-based compression can break the 1.58-bit barrier.

top_news.title: GPT-6 Astra Is the First Model OpenAI Classifies as Critical for Cybersecurity
top_news.dek: OpenAI has classified GPT-6 Astra as 'Critical' for cybersecurity, the first model to reach this threshold under its Preparedness Framework.
top_news.brief: GPT-6 Astra demonstrated the ability to identify unknown vulnerabilities in browsers and OS kernels while generating functional exploits. The model's release also highlighted a significant decline in chain-of-thought monitorability, raising concerns about transparency in high-capability systems.

top_news.title: Google Research Introduces Retrieve-for-Train (R4T): An RL-Compiled Diffusion Retriever for 12× to 20× Faster Query Fan-Out
top_news.dek: Google's R4T framework uses an RL-compiled diffusion retriever to accelerate query fan-out by up to 20x.
top_news.brief: Retrieve-for-Train (R4T) trains a fan-out model using reinforcement learning to optimize for diversity and groundedness. This model then synthesizes data for a 53.9M-parameter diffusion retriever, which generates retrieval directions in a single pass, significantly outperforming autoregressive methods.

top_news.title: Our framework for reporting model misalignment
top_news.dek: OpenAI has released a formal framework for tracking and disclosing model misalignment, accompanied by six recent incident reports.
top_news.brief: The new framework aims to move away from ad-hoc disclosures toward a systematic approach for investigating and reporting unexpected model behaviors. The initial release includes documentation on six specific instances of misalignment observed over the past six months.

primary.title: The AI data center e-waste problem is huge — and getting bigger
primary.summary: E-waste from the AI boom has been vastly underestimated, a new report warns. By 2050, it could become enough trash to fill 23 million shipping containers - roughly enough 40-foot containers to circle the world six times if lined up in a row. It's a significantly higher estimate of AI's e-waste than previous studies have found because the authors of the new report factor in all the infrastructure needed to support servers in data centers. The broader scope provides a clearer picture of junk AI leaves behind, according to the nonprofit Basel Action Network (BAN), which published the paper today.
